g5-implement.title: G5 Diagnose + fix the ideal-lap simulator over-acceleration: implement
g5-implement.imperative: [RE-PLANNED mid-run by user decision 2026-06-25: the original wider-views characterize/productize G5/G6 are DEFERRED to a follow-on issue; G4's NO-GO diagnosis redirected the run to the real C1 blocker.] Diagnose (systematic-debugging) WHY the canonical ideal-lap simulator (CapabilityEnvelope.from_parameters -> PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap) accelerates the RBR ideal lap to ~206.9 m/s (745 km/h) when the measured straight-line capability (P_max=629 kW, CdA=1.130, rho=1.148) implies a physical drag-limited terminal velocity of only ~99 m/s (356 km/h). The capability MEASUREMENT is physical (terminal velocity correct, identical OLD vs WIRED); the bug is in the ideal-lap machinery (envelope straight-line model and/or the simulator's longitudinal integration ignoring the drag-limited top speed). Find the locus, fix it so the ideal lap tops out near the envelope's terminal velocity, with L1-L4 physics truth evidence (e.g. an ideal-lap-top-speed-vs-terminal-velocity invariant test). If diagnosis shows it is NOT a contained bug but a deep modeling gap, STOP and surface to the Commander before a fix. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; dispatch implementer; integrate result.

Consider folding _validate_true_regime.py into the calibrate CLI as a post-sweep step.

b_b/CdA-pinned braking-frontier re-compare: the cold-start side-by-side ceiling@80 is a weakly-identified a_b<->b_b ridge (NOT terrain; corr(hilliness,b_b excess)=-0.22, divergence largest at flat Monza/Singapore). Thread altitude_assumed_flat from the wired braking terrain through SessionEstimate (session_estimator hardcodes False; the wired braking path now genuinely uses terrain).

C1 braking/fast-corner REAL unblock (HIGH): the U-clip at 2.0 is NOT braking-frontier depth (G3 recalibration left u_braking/u_fast_corner bit-identical Delta 0.000). Root cause = ideal-lap shape/alignment: PhysicsSimulator ideal lap hits aphysical 206.9 m/s (745 km/h) top speed + is longitudinally phase-misaligned vs the real lap, so in the braking/corner masks v_ideal is at apex (~25 m/s) while v_real is still fast (~66) at the same grid index -> ratio 2.5-3.7 pinned at 2.0. Fix = physics-aware/phase-aligned ideal-lap comparison OR compare vs a per-regime capability frontier (not point-aligned ideal-lap speed) AND fix the aphysical straight-line envelope top speed. This supersedes #510's 'ceiling under-call' diagnosis. New issue.

Aphysical ideal-lap straight-line top speed (HIGH, may be same root or separable): the CapabilityEnvelope/PhysicsSimulator produces 206.9 m/s ideal-lap top speed for RBR (real lap maxes ~95 m/s). The straight-line power-drag envelope is grossly unconstrained/miscalibrated. Affects ALL C1 regimes via the ideal-lap denominator. Investigate envelope P_max/CdA/top-speed cap.

DEFERRED (user re-plan 2026-06-25): the original G5/G6 wider-views characterize+productize (decoupled a_long into Traction/PowerDrag/Coast, single canonical longitudinal path) was deferred when the user redirected #518's remaining gates to the ideal-lap simulator fix. Pick up as a follow-on issue: characterize the decoupled estimator's blast-radius on the throttle/coast views, then productize if clean.

CORRECTION to tc8: the aphysical ideal-lap top speed is NOT an envelope/measurement miscalibration -- the measured P_max=629kW/CdA=1.130 imply a PHYSICAL 99 m/s (356 km/h) drag-limited terminal velocity, identical OLD vs WIRED. The bug is in the ideal-lap MACHINERY (CapabilityEnvelope.from_parameters straight-line model and/or PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap integration) producing 206.9 m/s = 2.1x terminal. Being fixed in the re-planned G5.

CONFIRMED THE C1 BINDING CONSTRAINT (strengthens tc7, HIGH): even on the G5-fixed PHYSICAL ideal lap, u_braking/u_fast_corner stay pinned at 2.0 (Delta 0.000 vs pre-fix, both stores). Root cause = ~3.3-3.8x LONGITUDINAL PHASE MISALIGNMENT: the point-aligned (shared distance grid) v_real/v_ideal comparison puts the real lap's braking/corner points against ideal-lap samples deep in the apex (v_ideal 17-25 vs v_real 63-66). The real unblock = a phase-aligned / physics-aware ideal-lap comparison OR a per-regime capability-frontier comparison (NOT point-aligned ideal-lap speed). This is THE C1 unblock; ceiling recalibration (#518) confirmed irrelevant to it (OLD vs WIRED <=0.04).

Straight-U over-call after the G5 fix (MED): the now-physical (lower) ideal lap mildly UNDER-calls straight speed -> straight U crossed from <1 to >1 (Italy 0.71->1.07, GB 0.83->1.23). Softer than the corner clip (ratio 1.08 vs 3.3) but straight U is no longer cleanly interpretable. Likely the ideal lap is slightly conservative on straights (power/traction frontier) -- investigate alongside the phase-alignment fix.
